name: Novel Prep Math Studio
install: test -f .env || cp .env.example .env; test -d .venv || python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/pip install -q --upgrade pip; .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt

terminals.name: flask-dev-server
terminals.command: cd /workspace && .venv/bin/python -c "from app import app; app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8888, debug=True, use_reloader=False)"
